description: Vulnerabilidad regulación hídrica. Bogotá. D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Área que representa el grado de susceptibilidad o de incapacidad de un sistema para afrontar los efectos adversos del cambio climático, y en particular la variabilidad del clima y los fenómenos extremos en la regulación hídrica. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are Cambio Climático, Ecosistemas, Hidrología, Vulnerabilidad. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2024-11-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
